correctness.rationale: The Cartier action on dx/y², x dx/y², dx/y is explicitly reconstructed in characteristic 5; semilinear iteration gives rank 0 iff A=c²+a²c+ab²=0. The exact quartic discriminant identity Delta=(a²+c)A-2b²(ac+b²) and surface relation a(ac+b²)=-c² imply support b=0. Translation z=c+3a² gives z²+ab²+a⁴, a geometrically integral normal D5 surface with isolated singular origin. At generic L0=(b,c), b is a DVR uniformizer, ord(c)=2; at L1=(b,c+a²), c is a unit; Delta=2b²c²/a then gives ord 6 and 2. Both package-local independent scripts executed and passed: verify_symbolic.py, verify_primefield.py; 125-point count is confirmatory only.
